about: Recorded ground and arm findings on shipped bodies (S36-P2 §5 AC-4; PR S36-CC10). scripts/check_cast.py CC-9 (feet) and CC-10 (arms.*) excuse a reading up to its recorded mm (+0.1 mm); deeper fails, and a finding whose reading passes is stale and fails. Never written by cast.py ground --write.

bob-achterberg.lane: S36-P4 (per-foot IK in GroundContact) / NPC lane
bob-achterberg.why: Walk frame 15, the first frame of the left stance: the foot 10.5 mm above the floor at touchdown, after skimming 4-11 mm over the frames before it

bob-achterberg.lane: S36-P4 (per-foot IK in GroundContact) / NPC lane
bob-achterberg.why: Walk frame 11, the last frame of the right stance: the foot 10.6 mm above the floor at lift-off

bob-achterberg.lane: cast lane / NPC lane (the standing idle's arm pose on the fused body; PR S36-CC10 recorded it)
bob-achterberg.why: G-9w stand, worst at stand:333 Right sleeve: 86.6 mm inside the body core (self.arm_in_thigh, bound 5 mm); over the bound on most of the 132 sampled stand frames. The skinned arm crosses the body's own surface in the 100STYLE idle (slices of stand:99 in the PR ledger)
